## New install

1. Download **Nightdesk-Setup-x.y.z.exe** below (under *Assets*).
2. Double-click it. If Windows shows **"Windows protected your PC"**, click **More info → Run anyway** (the app is not code-signed).
3. Click **Install**. NightDesk opens, and from then on it's on your desktop and in the Start menu.

## Already have NightDesk?

- **1.0.5 or newer:** nothing to do. It updates itself in the background and installs the update next time it closes (or click **Restart to update** when it says one is ready).
- **1.0.4 or older:** download the Setup below and run it **over** your current NightDesk. Don't uninstall first. All your data stays, and from then on updates come by themselves.

Your data lives on your laptop in `%USERPROFILE%\.nightdesk` (daily backups in `Documents\Nightdesk Backups`), outside the app folder, so installing, updating or even uninstalling never deletes it.

See the [README](https://github.com/Shoaib1M/NightDesk#readme) for features and optional Google Calendar / Spotify setup.
